review.reviewBody: I used to spend hours every week ordering food. Now it's simple, super easy, and I have free time to spend on other aspects of my restaurant.

@graph.name: Three steps, and nobody visits
@graph.description: There is no long planning stage, no IT project, and no AI agent to set up.

step.name: Send over the lists
step.text: Whatever format they are already in. Each account's lines and your prices go into a single admin screen, lined up with your codes.

step.name: Each customer gets a login
step.text: We set up each account, and the kitchen downloads the app. Most send something in before the day is out.

step.name: The order arrives complete
step.text: The kitchen has approved it, and it comes with its own number and a time, in the format your system takes.

@graph.name: Should I look for a Burnt AI alternative just to let kitchens order by talking?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no need. Your Burnt agents can stay exactly as they are. VoiceOrder Solutions sits beside them as one more ordering option: the customer speaks it, checks it and sends it. Nothing has to be turned off.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Burnt AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Burnt does far more, and it would be silly to pretend otherwise. Burnt reads channels we never touch and automates purchasing and invoice chasing, which we never go near. Our strength is different: the customer approves the order, so someone who knows that kitchen decides if it is right. If that is why you started looking for a Burnt AI alternative, you can add our app and keep Burnt.

@graph.name: Do the two products link up?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is no connection between Burnt and our app, and no joint support. Their agents keep passing what they process into your system. Ours arrive separately, either emailed with a file or fed straight into your system.

@graph.name: Can our accounts still email or WhatsApp their orders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and Burnt carries on reading them: it lists email, phone, voicemail, WhatsApp, SMS, EDI, portals and spreadsheets. We do not read incoming emails, texts, calls or other messages at all. A call that reaches your own desk carries no number from us, and no time stamp either: those come only with what is sent from our app.

@graph.name: How soon could our accounts be ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most distributors are up and running within 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens place their first order on day one. Burnt keeps running throughout, so there is no switchover to schedule.

@graph.name: Will anyone need to come to our site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not for this. We set up from the guides you send over, with no implementation project. Burnt describes hands-on onboarding, with their team working at your site; if that already happened for your agents, adding us does not repeat it.

@graph.name: What does VoiceOrder Solutions cost if we keep Burnt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Neither of us publishes a rate card. We quote per distributor once we know what you run, and Burnt quotes after a demo. Since the agents stay, the only figure to weigh is the price of adding our app.

@graph.name: Where do the Burnt details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Burnt's own website, read on 10 October 2026: the agent list and the on-site onboarding line off their homepage, and the channel list and the confidence-threshold wording off their sales and operations product page. We have left their accuracy and time-saving figures out, because those are their numbers to stand behind. If any of it has changed, this page is what needs correcting.
